proposals.title: Topic: SIP units are taxed per instalment
proposals.change: Add topic 'Selling your SIP? Each instalment has its own holding period'. Inputs: monthly amount, months, assumed return, redemption month. Code computes how many instalments are over 12 months (long-term) and the split of gain; use current LTCG/STCG rates verified by the fact reviewer. Use quiz_countdown or myth_vs_fact.
